human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Persist the current product decision before implementation: Ailuros consumes source-neutral evidence packages, never EverRun-private history. Raw evidence is immutable input; projection and product views are deterministic derivatives; optional AI explanation sits above facts.
human_pressure.why_now: The current repository has evidence/audit primitives but its product truth predates the Run Report + Dashboard + Problems direction.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: No reference-app concept in src/ailuros core.

machine_core.goal: Create an architecture document for EverRun dogfood ingestion, deterministic projection, reporting, aggregation, and evidence drill-down.
red_lines: No reference-app concept in src/ailuros core.
contracts: Raw evidence can be reprocessed into projections.
Product views never become source of truth.
failure_semantics: Unknown evidence remains unknown; it is not inferred as clean.

steps.title: Write data levels
details: Raw package -> stored evidence -> ExecutionProjection -> GovernanceSignal -> Report/Overview/Problems.

steps.title: Write MVP flow
details: Realtime event ingestion and distributed platform infrastructure are deferred.

steps.title: Write traceability rule
details: Every negative/warning status shown to users must have evidence refs.
LLM analysis must be visually/semantically separate from observed evidence.

acceptance: Document prohibits Ailuros from reading .everrun private history.
Document separates evidence, projection, signal, and UI layers.
Document defines Overview/Runs/Problems as product read views.

must_check: Document is consistent with governance-boundary doctrine.
No EverRun-specific model is placed in Ailuros core.
reject_if: Document turns Ailuros into an orchestrator or log platform.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Documentation-only pack validated with the existing v1.5 release closure checker.
